value.requirement: resolve at least 1 mOhm change in per-lane source impedance over a days-to-weeks window at >= 3 sigma against drift
value.margin: ~3x before the 3-4 mOhm Malucci runaway onset (conn.malucci_runaway_onset)

tier_verdict.pro: SHIPS the dV/dI trend feature (INA228 20-bit + integrated die-temp comp = clear headroom)
tier_verdict.standard: CONDITIONAL/BETA -- gated on (a) shunt family selection, (b) temperature compensation, (c) differential lane-vs-lane trending so common-mode drift cancels

validity_gates.promote_standard_to_full: in-situ multi-week temperature-compensated shunt drift < 0.3 mOhm

value.deciding_variable: the shunt BOM choice -- Bourns CSS-class load-life (<=1%/21,000h/130C) beats Vishay WSL-class (+/-(1.0%+0.5mOhm)/1000h) for this specific duty (stab.shunt_loadlife_bourns_css vs stab.shunt_loadlife_tcr_vishay_wsl); OWNER BOM DECISION QUEUED (interacts with OQ-11 + the CSS2H R-vs-K suffix flag)
